# phase-064 — Close the file loop: `.reload`, `.format`, and format-on-enter

## You must change `src/`

This phase declares `must_touch: [src/]`. The gate fails the phase unless at
least one changed file falls under it. Writing tests, documentation or a report
is not enough — if you finish without touching that area, the phase fails on
exactly that check.


## Evidence — verified finding

```
The file workflow is write-only in the wrong direction: `:load`/`:run` read files in, but nothing re-reads one (`reload` absent from commands.rs, verified), and nothing formats what was typed — `format` is absent too, although `src/formatter.rs` implements `rbfmt` and `rb format` ships it from the CLI. So a session that iterates on a file re-types `:load` by hand and pastes unformatted code it can never normalize without leaving. Ipp's `.format` goes one step further: auto-format on Enter as a toggle, so pasted code normalizes itself line by line.
```

**Re-verify this before you change anything.** If the finding no longer
reproduces on `main`, stop and write that to `FINDINGS.md` — a stale phase must
never be "fixed" by inventing a change.

## Goal

Add `.reload` (re-runs the last `:load`ed/`:run` file, erroring cleanly when there is none), `.format` (pretty-prints the current multiline buffer through `rbfmt` without executing it), and a `.format on|off` toggle that formats each entered line before execution. All three reuse the existing formatter; none changes what the formatter accepts.

## Method

1. Read `AGENTS.md` in full. Obey every hard rule; they are not negotiable.
2. Reproduce the finding. Record the exact command and the exact wrong output.
3. Write the failing test FIRST. Watch it fail. Do not touch production code
   until you have a red test that fails for the right reason.
4. Make the smallest change that turns it green.
5. Run the four gates yourself before claiming anything:

   ```bash
   cargo fmt --all -- --check
   cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings
   cargo test --all-targets
   ./rbops/verify.sh phase-064
   ```

6. Write `REPORT.md` in the exact shape required by `AGENTS.md` section 4.

## Definition of done

- [ ] `.reload` after `:load` re-executes the file and reproduces its output; `.reload` with no file loaded is a clean error naming `:load`, not a panic on missing state
- [ ] `.format` on an ugly-but-valid buffer prints the canonical form and leaves the buffer unexecuted (asserted: bindings unchanged after `.format`)
- [ ] with the toggle on, entering `set   x    to   1` executes `set x to 1` (proved by the binding existing afterwards); with it off, the line executes verbatim
- [ ] a buffer the formatter rejects is executed (or refused) exactly as with the toggle off — the toggle never converts a formatter error into a silent acceptance
- [ ] edge_* tests cover `.reload` after the file was deleted since loading (clean IO error with the path), `.format` on an empty buffer (no-op, no crash), and toggle state surviving `:reset` (it is a session preference, asserted on both sides)
